seoTitle: Connect a Broker to TradingView on Web & Mobile
metaDescription: A quick guide to linking a brokerage account to TradingView using the website or mobile app so you can trade directly from your charts.
intro: Connecting a broker to TradingView lets you trade directly from your charts on both the website and the mobile app. This guide covers the general process for linking your brokerage account so you can place and manage trades without leaving TradingView.

steps.heading: Open the Trading Panel
steps.body: Access the Trading Panel from a chart on either the website or the TradingView mobile app to begin connecting a broker.

steps.heading: Choose your broker
steps.body: Select your brokerage from the list of supported integrations available within TradingView.

steps.heading: Log in and authorize the connection
steps.body: Sign in with your broker credentials to authorize TradingView to link with your brokerage account.

steps.heading: Confirm the connection on mobile
steps.body: If you're setting this up on the mobile app, repeat the same broker selection and login steps to keep both platforms in sync.

steps.heading: Verify account details
steps.body: Once connected, check that your account balance and details display correctly inside the Trading Panel.

steps.heading: Start trading from your charts
steps.body: With your broker linked, you can place and manage trades directly from TradingView charts on web or mobile.

faq.question: Can I connect a broker to TradingView on mobile?
faq.answer: Yes, you can link a broker through the Trading Panel on both the mobile app and the website.

faq.question: Do I need a TradingView account to connect a broker?
faq.answer: Yes, you'll need to be signed into your TradingView account before linking a brokerage.

faq.question: Which brokers can I connect?
faq.answer: TradingView supports a range of brokerage integrations, selectable from within the Trading Panel.

faq.question: Is the connection process the same on web and mobile?
faq.answer: The core steps of selecting your broker and logging in are similar across both platforms.

faq.question: What can I do once my broker is connected?
faq.answer: Once connected, you can place and manage trades directly from your TradingView charts.
